task.description: Update CHANGELOG.md referencing GH #418; mark docs/issues/ISS-0128.json RESOLVED with corrected resolution + prevention text; check requirement mapping.

Requirement mapping checked: DB-03 (Transactional integrity) is the only requirement associated with this area and was already status=RELEASED in docs/requirements.yaml -- no status change needed or made, since diagnosis confirmed the DB-03 guarantee itself was never broken (only the test fixture that exercises it was buggy). docs/status/requirement_status.yaml has no pending diff (git status clean) since reqctl.py set-status was correctly not invoked.
